scientific.integrity: The primary full PDF was inspected at system (1.4)/(1.5), the notation defining time averages and effective rates, Lemma 2.3, Theorem 4.10, its proof, and Example 3 showing zero migration coefficients in the source's parameter domain. The theorem page and proof page were visually inspected. Exact symbolic replay verifies the witness. Related stochastic-logistic and polluted-population literature was checked for broader coverage. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The finding corrects the quantitative lower-bound clause of Theorem 4.10. It does not refute the theorem's qualitative strong-persistence conclusion and does not claim universal sharpness of the proof-derived bound.

title: The patchwise persistence lower bound omits pollution and outward migration
